test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Among the given words, select the one that will come third if they are arranged as per their order in an English dictionary.

Nostalgic, Nausea, Narcotic, Narrative, Nostril
solution:
Arranging the given words as per the English dictionary as-

i) **Nar**cotic

ii) **Narr**ative

iii) **Nau**sea

iv) **Nost**algic

v) **Nost**ril

Here, we can see that the **third word** is **Nausea**.
